learning_outcomes.text: Acquire basic metrological principles and skills.
Become acquainted with the basic principles and methods of process planning.

syllabus_topics: Measurement process capability and MSA measurement system analysis. Sources of variability in measurement.
Measurement in 1 coordinate. Municipal gauges, length gauges, 1st and 2nd order errors. Taylor's principle.
Measurement in 2 coordinates (measuring microscopes) and measurement in 3 coordinates (CMM)
Shape and position deviations. Principles of measurement and evaluation, measuring methods.
Surface texture, surface profile. Measuring methods.
bibliography: Dvořák, R. - Chmelík, V. - Marek, M.: Strojírenská metrologie. 1. vyd., Praha, ČVUT Praha, 1992, 122 s.
Metrology in Industry: The Key for Quality (ISTE) by French College of Metrology
Coordinate Metrology and CAx - Application in Industrial Production, Basics, Interfaces and Integration by Tilo Pfeifer, Dietrich Imkamp and Robert Schmitt
Coordinate Measuring Machines and Systems (Manufacturing Engineering and Materials Processing) by John A. Bosch (Hardcover - Apr 10, 1995)
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
